correctness.rationale: Finite uniform perturbation preserves properness for compatible metrics because every closed ball for the perturbed metric is a closed subset of a bounded-radius proper ball. Ishiki's density and G-delta statements therefore restrict to the proper-metric component. Algebraic independence makes the unordered-pair-to-distance map injective; this forces every distance-preserving map on at least three points to fix each point. O'Hara's rational-independence reconstruction theorem then upgrades abstract magnitude reconstruction to equality of ambient finite subsets.
